text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A row has erupted at the top level of the Namibian National Students Organisation (NANSO) with claims of financial mismanagement directed against its president Pohamba Shifeta.
- Namibia would consider approaching the International Court of Justice to rule on the amount of water the country could pump from the Okavango river, if Botswana objects to the plan.

- The speaker of the National Assembly Moses Tjitendero on Tuesday stressed the importance of parliamentary sovereignty after a two day meeting of speakers and representatives of seven SADC National Assemblies.

- The reform of national curricula in Namibia is set to make progress early next year, when the National Institute for Educational Development (NIED) will be hosting a sub-regional conference on curriculum development in Africa.
